mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past month signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline sufficiently over the past month, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4.5% indicates improving labor market conditions, reducing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.5% or 20-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand growth) and decline in FEDFUNDS (easing) create a dual signal of robust economic activity and lower interest rates, amplifying equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 does not rise sufficiently or FEDFUNDS does not decline enough, or 20-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO over the past month signals supply-side expansion, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise sufficiently over the past month, or 60-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In an early-stage tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising but below 2%), market anticipation of future hikes suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains outside the tightening range or 20-day returns are positive (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in UNRATE (lower unemployment) and rise in PAYEMS (employment growth) signal a robust labor market, reducing risk premiums and driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Either UNRATE does not fall below 5.0 or PAYEMS does not rise sufficiently, or 20-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A one-month surge in GDPC1 above 16,500 signals stronger-than-expected demand, prompting short-term equity price adjustments and positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not exceed 16,500 or 5-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (both INDPRO and GDPC1 above historical peaks), combined supply-demand balance supports equity gains over 60 days as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: Either INDPRO or GDPC1 does not meet their respective thresholds, or 60-day returns are not positive (p > 0.05).
